title: Plowman
summary: PLOW'MAN, noun One that plows or holds a plow. At last the robber binds the plowman and carries him off with the oxen. 1. A cultivator of grain; a husbandman. 2. A rustic; a countryman; a hardy labore

inlines.v: PLOW'MAN, noun One that plows or holds a plow. At last the robber binds the plowman and carries him off with the oxen. 1. A cultivator of grain; a husbandman. 2. A rustic; a countryman; a hardy laborer. PLOW'-MONDAY, noun The Monday after twelfth-day.
